about.title: About me
about.imageAlt: Mo — hairdresser at NOIR BASEL in Basel
paragraphs: On July 1, 2024, I took the decisive step and moved to Basel to take my career as a hairstylist to the next level. It was a step filled with risk, but driven by a clear vision: to give people a new sense of confidence through precision craftsmanship, style, and personality.

Born in Como, Italy, I spent my first nine years there — shaped by a culture where style, elegance, and appearance are simply part of everyday life. These roots continue to influence both my work and my standards of aesthetics to this day.
In 2009, I moved to Germany and had to adapt to an entirely new language and environment. Early on, I realized that only those who work consistently are able to shape their own future.

Due to financial circumstances, my hair was initially cut at home — and later even by myself. What began out of necessity gradually turned into my passion through discipline, dedication, and countless hours of practice. My first clients were school friends, while I continued to pursue my education with determination.

I achieved the highest level of secondary education and began studying mechanical engineering, but had to leave university due to my mother’s serious illness (acute leukemia). During this difficult time, I found my way into a renowned salon in Freiburg, Hairlimero, where my former boss, Dennis Orgona, recognized my potential and supported my growth.

After completing my apprenticeship, I continued to set high standards for myself: numerous advanced trainings and seminars, earning the title of third-best hairstylist in Baden-Württemberg, and successfully graduating from the master craftsman program at the Zieger Academy in Konstanz have all shaped my journey.

Today, I combine experience, precision, and passion in my craft. With Noir Basel, I have created a modern and timeless space where everyone is welcome and where looks are designed to highlight confidence and individuality.
But this is only the beginning. My vision goes further — to inspire people, share knowledge, and elevate the craft to an entirely new level.

sections.body: If you do not attend without prior notice, the full service fee may be charged.

sections.title: § 4 Lateness
sections.body: Significant lateness may shorten or reschedule the appointment at NOIR BASEL’s discretion.

sections.title: § 5 Scope
sections.body: These terms apply to bookings via the website and appointments at NOIR BASEL.

sections.title: § 6 Liability
sections.body: Liability is limited to the extent permitted by law. No liability is assumed for valuables.

sections.title: § 7 Warranty
sections.body: Defects must be reported promptly, at the latest within 5 days after the service.

sections.title: § 8 Final provisions
sections.body: If individual clauses are invalid, the remainder stays in effect. Swiss law applies unless mandatory law provides otherwise.
